verdict.rationale: Anrok's product tax category (PTC) system explicitly ties taxability determinations to jurisdiction rules (anrok-docs-26, anrok-docs-14), and AI Atlas lets users ask about sales tax and see the reasoning grounded in their own transactions/registrations/filings/certificates (anrok-docs-15), which directly supports the 'research visible' requirement. However, the evidence pack lacks concrete examples of state-by-state SaaS taxability differences or bundled-offering-specific handling, and there's no independent/hands-on validation that Anrok correctly resolves the hardest edge cases — the HN comment focuses on multi-platform integration, not taxability accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit bundled-offering taxability logic, documented state-by-state SaaS divergence examples, and independent verification of correctness on hard cases.
